column_interpretation: separated samples can indicate roof/wall/holes or multiple surfaces; not automatic false-double-surface labels

diagnostic_strata.source: fixed prior mesh compared with observed UAS at evaluation only
diagnostic_strata.reference_absence: no observed UAS in fixed XY cell
diagnostic_strata.temporal_label: manual actual-image/input-lineage interpretation only; distance does not establish change
diagnostic_strata.observation_support: report original MVS/ALS/reference point support independently; absence of MVS is not proof of absent image observation

case_selection.eligible: fixed XY cells with at least3voxel-selected observed UAS points
case_selection.score: native mean UAS-to-triangle distance minus changed mean on identical reference point identities
examples: largest positive reduction if one exists
largest negative reduction if one exists
case_selection.use: post-freeze diagnostic selection; show signed values and all-cell machine-readable table; no favorable parameter selection

density_sensitivity: one factor at a time: surface0.05/0.1/0.2m with reference0.1m, then reference0.05/0.2m with surface0.1m; not Cartesian sweep

display.selection: original point nearest fixed voxel center then deterministic ordered cap

render_aggregation: unweighted per-image means per region/domain; report image and pixel counts; pooled image-weighted and region-macro values remain descriptive due overlap
geometry_aggregation: per region and equal-region descriptive macro; preserve distinct point-NN and mesh-surface estimands
